nodes.label: CPF Assessment (Cyber-Physical Function Assessment)
nodes.rationale: Static client-side app, no server and no build step; unit of analysis is the individual cyber-physical function, not the organization or sector; four independent cumulative dimensions; essential capabilities carry non-compensable thresholds never absorbed into a mean; remediation priority and verification priority kept distinct. Orientational tool, not legal advice.

nodes.label: CCE logic (Consequence-driven Cyber-informed Engineering)
nodes.rationale: Target profile built from intolerable consequences → compromise paths → required capabilities, following CCE (Bochman & Freeman 2021, INL).

nodes.label: Forza probatoria (evidentiary strength)
nodes.rationale: Assessed separately per level (corroborated / partial / not determinable). Uncertainty does not lower the assessed level; it instead generates a distinct verification priority, separate from remediation priority.

nodes.rationale: Essential capabilities follow weakest-link logic and are never absorbed into an average; surfaced on the dashboard as 'divari essenziali'.
